gangliosides, which are a class of glycosphingolipids, are present in the supernatants of renal cell carcinoma (RCC) explants and inhibit the activation of nuclear factor kappaB (NFkapaB) in T cells.
RCC cells secrete gangliosides, and these gangliosides inhibit NFkappa-B activation in T cells, thus contributing to immunosuppression in RCC.
